verdicts.item:
4. A backup whose integrity check fails is deleted and reported.
   Shows A18-1, A18-2. [witness: verification:registry_a18_integrity_failure_deleted_and_reported]
statements: after a run whose deletions succeeded: no backup older than 30 × 24 hours and no   -- A18-1

quotes: assert _at(bad_day, 3) not in kept  # deleted, not kept
assert _temporary(rt) == []  # its decrypted copy and itself removed
verdicts.why: The check detects that the integrity-failed backup is neither kept nor left temporary and that at least one new diagnostic is written. It does not assert the 720-hour retention invariant or that every retained backup is encrypted, consistent, checked, and correctly recorded.
